editorial.summary: Carlton is Melbourne's university quarter - Lygon Street's Italian heritage strip beside the University of Melbourne, with a young international population and big Chinese, Indian and Malaysian student communities.
loves: Walk to the University of Melbourne and RMIT
Lygon Street - the original Italian food strip, plus great Asian eats
thingsToKnow: Student demand keeps rooms competitive around semester start
Apartment towers dominate - houses are rare and pricey
editorial.transportNote: Swanston Street trams run to the CBD; most of Carlton is a short walk from the university.
